notes: Python job queue. Five required planted bugs, one optional, two decoys, no explicit state machine (an enum alone does not count). Ships a pre-existing REPORT.md to test the no-overwrite rule.

expected.title: is_running/is_done/is_failed duplicate status and drift (is_running never cleared, is_done set before failure)
Worker claims jobs with read-then-write and no lock; two workers can run the same job
Status written from worker, api and repository with no transition guard; completed jobs can be cancelled or reset to pending
Completion email sent before the COMPLETED commit and its errors are swallowed
Raw DB status loaded without validation; job_label has no entry for cancelled
Handler lookup sits outside the try, so an unknown kind leaves the job stuck in running

decoys.why: Independent feature flags read from the environment.
Atomic claim with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. This is the fix, not the bug.
